articles.title: Zoetis to Host Webcast and Conference Call on Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
articles.mainIdea: Zoetis to Host Webcast and Conference Call on Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
articles.summary: Business Wire: Zoetis to Host Webcast and Conference Call on Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results. PARSIPPANY, N.J., December 30, 2025--Zoetis Inc. (NYSE:ZTS) will host a webcast and conference call at 8:30 a.m. (ET) on Thursday, February 12, 2026. Chief Executive Officer Kristin Peck and Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Wetteny Joseph will review fourth quarter and full year 2025 financial results and respond to questions from financial analysts.
